name: pmcro-runtime
_comment: Full cross-repo index for pmcro-runtime (EC-019 reconciliation 2026-08-21, expanded same day per Shawn's 'all skills into project' request). ALL 25 plugins are listed here so the frontend /skills browsing page shows the complete catalog. Only plugins with "stage": true are actually mirrored by MarketplaceSkillsMaterializer into the live agent's StagingRoot / advertised via MAF's AgentSkillsProvider -- see ARCH-SKILLS-ONDEMAND-001.md in this same folder for why staging is still curated and what unblocks widening it safely.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Scaffolds and updates PMCR-O skills, plugins, MCP specs, and assets (create-* + update-skill).

plugins.name: pmcro-orchestrator
plugins.description: PMCR-O Orchestrator phase: run one governed macro-cycle (Plan -> Make -> Check -> Reflector) and seal a trail.

plugins.name: pmcro-planner
plugins.description: PMCR-O Planner phase: decompose the active seed into a bounded, checkable unit; emit PlannerFrame.

plugins.name: pmcro-maker
plugins.description: PMCR-O Maker phase: execute the plan; stub-and-halt on TYPE1 flags; emit MakerFrame.

plugins.name: pmcro-checker
plugins.description: PMCR-O Checker phase: independently re-verify every SuccessCriterion; emit CheckerFrame.

plugins.name: pmcro-reflector
plugins.description: PMCR-O Reflector phase: decide ACCEPT/HALT, seal disposition, update seed-queue.
